scope: ARC source only; all valid items F union C for traditional statistics; only F half for response parameters

observation.real_options: n_options agrees with finite positive char_lens; padding has no finite loglik; all real option loglik finite; >=2 options; legal integer gold; unique item and model IDs
observation.u: L_k/h_k; h_k stored positive finite character length; no token/raw-L substitution or length imputation
observation.argmax: smallest original option index among exact ties
observation.invalid: invalid item excluded for all source statistics and source fit; invalid rows explicitly masked, not zero-filled as observations

statistics.bins: 10 equal-width [b/10,(b+1)/10), b=0..8; last [0.9,1]; empty bin contributes0; bin=min(floor(10*c),9)
statistics.Brier: mean_i sum_k (p_ik-1[k=gold_i])^2; no division by K
statistics.R50: mean error among ceil(N/2) items ordered c descending then canonical item ID ascending

ALS.objective: min sum_(m,i valid) (ell_mi-a_m+s_m*b_i)^2; unweighted source observed cells
ALS.reference_items: source F items with >=20 valid reference Q0 models; noneligible b=NaN
ALS.reference_models: all Q0 rows in exact reference org set; any row <2 eligible items => diagnostic failure, not implicit drop
ALS.initialization: b=standardize(-mean_valid_models ell per eligible item), population SD
ALS.gauge: mu=mean(raw_b),sd=std(raw_b,ddof0); b=(raw_b-mu)/sd; a_new=a_old-s_old*mu; s_new=s_old*sd; if dot(b,initial_b)<0 negate b and s
ALS.convergence: max_abs(b_new-b_old)<1e-6; <=500 iterations; nonconvergence diagnostic failure; no changing seed/tol or silently dropping
ALS.post_convergence: recompute model OLS and report normal intercept/slope, objective/history, iterations, mean_b,var_b,sign_dot

projection.items: scored model valid source F intersect finite reference b only
projection.sigma: sqrt(mean((ell-a+s*b)^2)); residual RMS with fitted intercept, population SD; not logistic scale
projection.eligible: n_valid_qualifiedF>=100 AND Var(b)>1e-12 AND Var(ell)>1e-6 AND finite s>1e-8 AND finite sigma>1e-8 AND finite theta; all9 source summaries finite
projection.target_data: no target items, target valid counts, target statistics, org labels as predictor columns

two_stage_qualification.Q0: ARC/HS metadata threshold qualified fixed snapshot; used to freeze all splits and reference membership
two_stage_qualification.context_rows: for each of125 projection contexts independently require all F features plus all9 source summaries finite; same rows for B/C/L/F, both families, all configs and both endpoints
two_stage_qualification.Q_H: union of five qualified outer-test rows, unique model IDs; size determined in A3, not presumed6666
two_stage_qualification.training: each training context has its own qualified rows; do not screen using a heldout-dependent other-context fit; compute institution weights after context qualification
two_stage_qualification.no_repartition: no redraw/rebalance/refit based on source qualification; report context reasons and final OOF exclusions
two_stage_qualification.thresholds: Q_H>=300 models,>=30 orgs; every qualified outer supervised train >=20 orgs; each inner train/valid nonempty and all5 outer tests nonempty; failure INCONCLUSIVE with actual block, never experimental PASS
